title: Hashed Pair Probability
statement: Let $S$, $\alpha$, and $\beta$ be finite sets, with $S$ nonempty, and let $f\colon S\to\alpha\to\beta$ and $X$ be a probability distribution on $\alpha$. For $s\in S$ and $y\in\beta$, the distribution of $(s,f(s,x))$, with $s$ uniform on $S$ and $x$ distributed according to $X$ independently, assigns probability $\frac{1}{|S|}\sum_{x\in\alpha:\,f(s,x)=y}X(x)$ to $(s,y)$.
